\begin{equation*}
    g(c)=\frac{1}{2025!}\left\lfloor \frac{2025! f(M+c)}{M}\right\rfloor.
\end{equation*}
We can write 
\begin{equation*}
    g(0)+g(4M)+g(1848374)+g(10162574)+g(265710644)+g(44636594)=\frac{p}{q}
\end{equation*}
where $p$ and $q$ are coprime positive integers. What is the remainder when $p+q$ is divided by $99991$?

<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>analysis to=python code<|message|>def phi(n):
    result = n
    x = n
    p = 2
    while p * p <= x:
        if x % p == 0:
            while x % p == 0:
                x //= p
            result -= result // p
        p += 1 if p == 2 else 2
    if x > 1:
        result -= result // x
    return result

    phi = list(range(N+1))

                phi[j] -= phi[j] // i
    return phi

<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>analysis to=python code<|message|>def compute_spf(N):
    spf = list(range(N+1))
    spf[0] = 0
    spf[1] = 1

        if spf[i] == i:
            for j in range(i*i, N+1, i):
                if spf[j] == j:
                    spf[j] = i
    return spf

def compute_phi_from_spf(N, spf):
    phi = [0]*(N+1)
    phi[0]=0
    phi[1]=1
    for i in range(2, N+1):
        p = spf[i]
        if p == i:  # prime
            phi[i] = i-1
        else:
            m = i // p
            if m % p == 0:
                phi[i] = phi[m] * p
            else:
                phi[i] = phi[m] * (p-1)
    return phi

def find_smallest_divisor_for_c_spf(c, max_m):

            exp_mod = e % ph
            M_mod = pow(3, exp_mod, m)
        S_mod = (M_mod + (t % m)) % m
        if S_mod == 0:
            return m
    return None
